# Pi native composer captures

Captured from the official Pi native terminal runtime with the owned, credential-free
scripted provider during the 2026-11-14 adapter investigation. Runtime 1.5.2 is a
historical observation, never an admission gate. `.txt` is the plain visible pane;
`.ansi` retains SGR styles, including Pi's reverse-video cursor cell. Private
project paths are replaced with `/fixture`.

Empty, visible/whitespace/multiline/wrapped drafts, busy text/tool headers, built-in
model/settings pickers and an inline extension selector exercise the default grammar.
The empty capture and spaces-only drafts with their cursor returned home have
identical composer bytes. The external custom overlay also preserves the default
composer. Those fixtures record accepted observation limits in TRUST-POLICY;
they do not assert draft or external-overlay protection.
